baseline_implementation: Test-only copy of the previous SessionLibrary.export file-work path
candidate: Cancellable SessionExporter with per-block autorelease pools
limitations: Benchmark run alone with parallel testing disabled; filesystem caches are warm.
Strategy order alternates across three pairs; this small sample does not establish a speed improvement.
FileManager.copyItem may use filesystem cloning; streaming intentionally provides cancellation checkpoints.
RSS is the cumulative peak of the entire test host, not isolated export memory or a per-strategy allocation measurement.
No wall-clock cancellation deadline is claimed for synchronous kernel filesystem calls.
